import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { execFileSync, spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const SCRIPT = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "followups.mjs");
const README =
  "# Follow-ups\n\n<!-- next-id: 13 -->\n\n<!-- list:start (generated by scripts/followups.mjs index) -->\n<!-- list:end -->\n";
const entry = (id, title = "Something is left") =>
  `---\nid: ${id}\ntitle: ${JSON.stringify(title)}\npriority: low\nneeds: fix\n---\n\nWhat is wrong.\n\n## Done when\n\nIt is right.\n`;

/**
 * A scratch repository holding one open entry, F12, plus the given files. Those named in
 * `staged` are added to the index; the rest stay untracked.
 */
function ledger(files = {}, staged = []) {
  const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "followups-"));
  execFileSync("git", ["init", "-q"], { cwd: root });
  const all = {
    "docs/follow-ups/README.md": README,
    "docs/follow-ups/F12.md": entry("F12"),
    ...files,
  };
  for (const [path, text] of Object.entries(all)) {
    mkdirSync(dirname(join(root, path)), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(join(root, path), text);
  }
  if (staged.length)
    execFileSync("git", ["add", "--", ...staged], { cwd: root });
  const run = (...args) => {
    const result = spawnSync("node", [SCRIPT, ...args], {
      env: { ...process.env, FOLLOWUPS_ROOT: root },
      encoding: "utf8",
    });
    return { code: result.status, text: result.stdout + result.stderr };
  };
  run("index");
  return { run, done: () => rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }) };
}

function problems(files) {
  const { run, done } = ledger(files);
  const result = run("check");
  done();
  return result;
}

test("a ledger whose references all resolve passes", () => {
  const result = problems({
    "notes.md": "See F12.\n",
    "src/a.ts": "// FOLLOWUP(F12): finish this\n",
  });
  assert.equal(result.code, 0, result.text);
});

test("a reference to an entry that has been deleted fails, in prose and in code", () => {
  const result = problems({
    "notes.md": "See F40.\n",
    "src/a.ts": "// FOLLOWUP(F41): finish this\n",
    "src/b.test.ts": "it.failing('loads [known gap F42]', () => {});\n",
  });
  assert.equal(result.code, 1);
  assert.match(result.text, /notes\.md:1: F40 is not an open follow-up/);
  assert.match(result.text, /src\/a\.ts:1: F41 is not an open follow-up/);
  assert.match(result.text, /src\/b\.test\.ts:1: F42 is not an open follow-up/);
});

test("every id inside a range is checked", () => {
  const result = problems({
    "notes.md": "Still open (F11–F12), and F12 to F13.\n",
  });
  assert.match(result.text, /F11 is not an open follow-up/);
  assert.match(result.text, /F13 is not an open follow-up/);
});

test("an id-shaped value in code that is not a reference passes", () => {
  const result = problems({
    "src/keys.ts":
      'press("F11");\nconst red = "#F40";\nconst url = "https://TODO.example";\n',
  });
  assert.equal(result.code, 0, result.text);
});

test("a bare marker comment fails, and so does FOLLOWUP without an id", () => {
  const result = problems({
    "src/a.ts": "// TODO: later\n/* fixme soon */\n// FOLLOWUP: no id\n",
    "tool.py": "# @todo tidy\n",
  });
  assert.match(result.text, /src\/a\.ts:1: bare TODO/);
  assert.match(result.text, /src\/a\.ts:2: bare fixme/);
  assert.match(result.text, /src\/a\.ts:3: FOLLOWUP needs an id/);
  assert.match(result.text, /tool\.py:1: bare todo/);
});

test("a malformed entry is reported by name, not as a crash", () => {
  const result = problems({
    "docs/follow-ups/F13.md": "---\nid: F13\npriority: urgent\n---\n\nText.\n",
  });
  assert.equal(result.code, 1);
  assert.match(result.text, /F13\.md: title is missing/);
  assert.match(result.text, /F13\.md: priority must be one of/);
  assert.match(result.text, /F13\.md: has no "## Done when"/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(result.text, /TypeError/);
});

test("a stale list fails until index is run", () => {
  const { run, done } = ledger();
  assert.equal(run("check").code, 0);
  assert.equal(run("new", 'Fix the "quoted": thing | now').code, 0);
  assert.equal(run("check").code, 0, "new leaves the list current");
  assert.match(run("new", "Another").text, /F14\.md/);
  done();
});

test("new refuses to overwrite an entry when next-id is behind", () => {
  const { run, done } = ledger({ "docs/follow-ups/F13.md": entry("F13") });
  const result = run("new", "Would overwrite");
  assert.equal(result.code, 1);
  assert.match(result.text, /F13 already exists/);
  done();
});

test("an unknown command prints usage", () => {
  const { run, done } = ledger();
  assert.match(run("chekc").text, /usage: followups check/);
  done();
});

/** A tracked and an untracked file whose names contain `special`, each citing a deleted entry. */
function specialNames(special) {
  const tracked = `notes${special}tracked.md`;
  const untracked = `src/a${special}untracked.ts`;
  const { run, done } = ledger(
    { [tracked]: "See F40.\n", [untracked]: "// FOLLOWUP(F41): finish this\n" },
    [tracked],
  );
  const result = run("check");
  done();
  assert.equal(result.code, 1, result.text);
  assert.ok(
    result.text.includes(`${tracked}:1: F40 is not an open follow-up`),
    result.text,
  );
  assert.ok(
    result.text.includes(`${untracked}:1: F41 is not an open follow-up`),
    result.text,
  );
}

test("unresolved references in Unicode filenames fail", () => {
  specialNames("\u00e9");
});

test("unresolved references in tab filenames fail", () => {
  specialNames("\t");
});

test("unresolved references in newline filenames fail", () => {
  specialNames("\n");
});
